common_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common_unavailable: Couldn't reach muelle. Check your connection and try again.
common_server_error: muelle responded with an error. Try again in a moment.
common_timeout: muelle took too long to respond. Try again in a moment.
common_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select it and copy it by hand.
common_forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
common_read_only_token: The token is read-only: it can't deploy or change variables. Use one that isn't read-only.
common_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
common_bad_origin: muelle doesn't accept changes from this address. Use the panel's address: https://<panel domain>, with the HTTPS port from Settings if it isn't 443. If muelle is behind another proxy, this address goes in MUELLE_PANEL_ORIGIN.
common_panel_moved: The panel moved to {origin}: this address no longer accepts changes. Continue there. If it doesn't respond within a minute, reload this page: if muelle-caddy didn't start with the new port, muelle goes back to the previous ports on its own and this address accepts changes again.
common_ambiguous_session: There is more than one session cookie: clear the panel cookies and sign in again.
not_found_body: The route you're looking for doesn't exist.
